title: The internet discovers TLA+. Now what?
title_zh: 互联网发现了 TLA+，接下来呢？
author: Anna Mészáros, Szilvia Ujváry, Kseniia Strelbytska, Balázs Szilágyi, Ferenc Huszár

retrieval.method: Direct HTTPS article retrieval after the web reader initially failed; the publisher's text was also available in web search through its short link.
retrieval.date_basis: Visible publication date, time element, and citation_publication_date metadata agree.
retrieval.playground_inspection: Published inline TLA+ specification and precomputed TLC statistics inspected; the N=3 safety variants were executed unchanged from temporary files.

verification.original_model: Seven finite WorkerProgress checks matched their expected outcomes, including three intentional counterexamples. Deadlock checking remained enabled; Wait supplies explicit self-loops.
verification.publisher_model: With N=3 and CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE for invariant-only checking, the normal Election model completed with 38 distinct states; DoubleVote produced a counterexample with 6 actions and 7 states.
verification.not_reproduced: Publisher liveness and scaling experiments, the Verus proof pipeline, implementation-refinement proofs, and reported dataset/model-evaluation results.

followups.topic: Verus spec, proof, and exec modes
followups.scope: Three independently written programs verified, compiled, and executed. Five temporary incorrect variants rejected with the expected diagnostics. Ordinary Rust main harnesses are outside verification. Not a reproduction of the article's Verus pipeline or a system-level liveness/refinement proof.

followups.topic: Clamp function versus predicate specifications and comparison with TLA+
followups.scope: Function/predicate equivalence on valid intervals, existence and uniqueness, universal bounds, an alternative executable implementation, and a deliberately weak contract were checked. The TLA+ snippets are explanatory and were not model-checked.

notes.archive_type: Brief article synopsis, independently sourced Chinese guide, original discussion, and reproducible local experiments; not a full-text translation or reproduction.
notes.license: No open redistribution license established for the article; publisher prose and model code are linked, not reproduced.
notes.authorship: WorkerProgress, the Verus examples, and their discussion are assistant-authored. Publisher model results are attributed and independently checked only within the recorded scope. Discussion is not presented as recorded user opinion.
notes.claims: The counts of specification/property pairs, proofs, and evaluation tasks are publisher-reported, not independently audited.
